name: YLDS
oneLiner: YLDS is Figure's SEC-registered face-amount certificate paying SOFR-minus-35bps daily interest, backed by short-term Treasuries and repos.
collateral: Short-dated U.S. Treasury bills, overnight Treasury repo, a government money market fund, and cash held by Figure Certificate Company (FCC), an SEC-registered face-amount certificate company; qualified assets are on deposit with UMB Bank N.A. and Flagstar Bank N.A.
pegMechanism: Registered face-amount certificate issued and surrendered at $0.01 per certificate; daily simple interest at SOFR minus 35bps (minimum 0%), paid monthly in USD and automatically reinvested unless opted out; mint and surrender through Figure Certificate Company subject to KYC and offering terms; registered under the Securities Act of 1933 and Investment Company Act of 1940

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Figure Certificate Company issues unsecured face-amount certificates backed by its qualified assets, including short-term Treasury securities, Treasury repos and cash. This Treasury-backed security is distinct from Figure's private-credit lending products. The December 31, 2025 KPMG audit remains the latest independent assurance located; the June 30, 2026 interim financial statements are explicitly unaudited.
